title: AI generated photo of movie theater
content: I decided to ask AI to create a photo of a movie theater I visit a lot in dreams. Outside of the actual movie room as u turn to the left there's a concession stand with food and snacks and it feels like I'm always about to be late, or sometimes I fall because it's so steep. The first image feels eerily close to what I see but I asked it to redo it so we can see the movie screen since that's normally the angle I see but thought I would share in case other have similar dreams.
